observations: Handheld torchlight with a black body and decorative pink, green, and orange stripes.
The torch is resting in a custom foam cutout inside an orange plastic carrying case.
A purple rechargeable battery (likely 18650 or 26650 size) is visible in the case.
A USB charging cable and a black lanyard are included.
A black retail box is visible in the background with the text 'FLASHLIGHT' and 'PROTABLE BRIGHT'.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'KC KENRICH' are visible.
The photo has a date stamp of '23/07/2026', which is in the future.

claims.evidence: The photo does not show the head of the torch extended or retracted to demonstrate a zoom function.
The body appears to be metal, but it is more likely aluminum alloy than iron; material cannot be confirmed remotely.
A handheld torch of this size cannot produce 600W of power; this is a physical impossibility for the battery and LED shown.
No photo of the beam or light throw is provided.

risks.risk: The LED or internal circuitry may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video of the torch being switched on and cycling through modes.

risks.risk: The included rechargeable battery may be dead or have very low capacity.
risks.proof: A video showing the torch staying lit for at least 5 minutes without being plugged in.

risks.risk: The charging port may be damaged or loose.
risks.proof: A photo of the torch plugged into a power source with a charging indicator light visible.

risks.risk: The photo may be a stock image or old due to the future date stamp.
risks.proof: A photo of the item next to a handwritten note with today's date.

proof_requests: Video of the torchlight turned on and cycling through its light modes.
Photo of the torch plugged in and charging.
Photo of the item with a handwritten note showing today's date to verify the photo is current.
response.reason: The item is a generic rechargeable LED torchlight. While the seller's technical claims are exaggerated and the date stamp is incorrect, it can be priced as a generic unit in non-working condition.
